articles.author: Sam Meredith
articles.title: Russia could attack a NATO country within months, Danish intelligence warns - CNBC
articles.description: The new threat assessment joins a growing chorus of Russia warnings from top European security officials and lawmakers in recent days.
articles.content: Danish intelligence officials have warned that Russia could launch a "limited" military attack against a NATO member in the coming months, saying the Kremlin appears more willing to take risks after … [+2254 chars]
